name: CA3019
description: Ultra-fast low-capacitance matched diodes (6 diodes: quad + 2 individual)

transfer_function.notes: Matched diodes ensure precise threshold detection within 2mV

amplitude_window_function.description: Creates sharp amplitude windows by using matched diode pairs as threshold detectors
amplitude_window_function.equation: window(signal, low, high) = diode_on(signal - low) * diode_on(high - signal)
amplitude_window_function.notes: Sharp transitions at thresholds due to exponential diode characteristic

used_in: Paik/Abe Video Synthesizer - PED Control / Colorizer (page 28)
